peer_injection.description: Web servers can request their service name (e.g., 'http', 'https') be added to the allowed services list in the default zone.
Database services can request their service name (e.g., 'mysql', 'postgresql') be added to the allowed services list in the default zone.
SSH servers can ensure 'ssh' is in the allowed services list.
DNS resolvers can request their UDP/TCP ports (e.g., '53/udp') be added to the allowed ports list.
